title: Employee Management, HR & Payroll
brief: Enhance the five already-wired employee/HR pages with new fields from BIZ-MS0: clearance_level, OT policy, shift differential, learning academy integration, timecard approval workflow, full payroll cycle, employee lifecycle management, timecard audit trail, and a fully live DepartmentDashboardPage. All pages are already calling real APIs — this milestone layers depth, compliance, and new backend capabilities on top of the existing wiring.

phases.title: Employee Directory & Profile Enhancements
phases.description: Enhance EmployeeDirectoryPage with BIZ-MS0 new fields (clearance_level, OT policy, shift differential), cert expiry warnings, manager override capabilities, and quick links. Enhance EmployeeProfilePage with a Learning Academy tab wired to learningPathEngine and employeeCertifications.

units.title: Enhance EmployeeDirectoryPage with new fields, cert warnings, and manager override

steps.instruction: Read web/src/pages/EmployeeDirectoryPage.tsx in full (617 lines) to understand existing edit modal fields, state structure, and API calls

Extend the edit modal to include three new field sections: (a) Clearance: a <select> with options [shop_floor, lead, hr_manager, admin] mapped to the clearance_level field; (b) OT Policy: a <select> with options [daily_8hr_CA, weekly_40hr_FLSA, exempt, none] mapped to overtime_policy; (c) Shift Differential: a number input (step=0.01, min=0, placeholder='0.00') for shift_differential_rate plus a <select> for shift_differential_type [flat_dollar, percent_of_base, none]

On the employee card/row, display a cert expiry warning badge: iterate the employee's certifications array. If any cert has expiry_date within 30 days from today (Date.now()), render a red badge with text 'CERT EXP' and tooltip listing the cert names and exact expiry dates. Use CSS class 'badge-danger' or equivalent Tailwind classes bg-red-600 text-white

Add manager override panel (visible only to users with clearance_level >= 'lead'): a collapsible 'Manager Actions' section per employee row with two actions — (a) 'Close Forgotten Shift': calls POST /api/erp/shift-clock-out with { employeeId, forced: true, change_reason: string } and requires a change_reason textarea before submission; (b) 'Edit Time Entry': opens a modal listing today's job_time_entries for the employee, allows editing hours_worked field with a required change_reason field, then calls PATCH /api/erp/job-time/:id with { hours_worked, change_reason }

Add quick links to each employee card: (a) 'View Timecard' button — navigates to /timecards?employeeId=:id; (b) 'Clock In For' button — visible only to clearance_level >= 'hr_manager', calls POST /api/erp/shift-clock-in with { employeeId } on behalf of the employee and shows a success toast
Update the updateEmployee() call in web/src/api/client.ts to include clearance_level, overtime_policy, shift_differential_rate, shift_differential_type in the request body
Run npm run build:fast and fix any TypeScript errors

deliverables.description: Edit modal with clearance_level, OT policy, shift differential fields; cert expiry warnings; manager override close-shift and edit-time-entry; quick links View Timecard and Clock In For
updateEmployee() extended to send new HR fields; new clockInForEmployee() function added

exit_conditions: Edit modal renders clearance_level select, overtime_policy select, and shift_differential_rate/type inputs
Saving edit modal sends all three new fields to the backend and reflects updated values without page reload
Employee with cert expiring in <= 30 days shows red CERT EXP badge with tooltip listing cert name and date
Manager can close a forgotten shift only after entering a non-empty change_reason
Manager can edit a time entry with required change_reason; PATCH sent to /api/erp/job-time/:id
'View Timecard' quick link navigates to /timecards?employeeId=:id
'Clock In For' button visible only to hr_manager+ and calls clock-in on behalf of employee

BIZ-MS0 not complete: PATCH /api/erp/job-time/:id route does not exist or does not accept change_reason
BIZ-MS0 not complete: forced clock-out endpoint does not accept change_reason parameter

phases.title: Timecard & Payroll Enhancement
phases.description: Enhance TimecardPage with setup/production split, FLSA OT calculation, shift differential display, approval workflow (draft→submitted→approved→locked), and ADP/Paychex CSV export. Enhance PayrollPage with full cycle management: deductions, YTD display, shift differential application, and period finalization.

units.title: Enhance TimecardPage with setup/production split, OT workflow, and CSV export

steps.instruction: Read web/src/pages/TimecardPage.tsx in full (357 lines) to understand existing day-view structure, state shape, and current API calls

Enhance the per-day time row to show a three-way breakdown: setup_hours (from job_time_entries where process_type='setup'), production_hours (process_type='run'), idle_hours (shift_hours - setup_hours - production_hours). Display as a stacked bar or three labeled columns. Source data from the existing getTimecardEntries() response — ensure the API response includes process_type on each entry

Add OT highlighting. Read the employee's overtime_policy from the employee record (fetch via getEmployee(employeeId) if not already loaded). Apply FLSA daily OT rule: highlight any day where total_hours > 8 in yellow. Apply FLSA weekly OT rule: compute running weekly total; highlight the weekly OT row in orange when weekly_total > 40. For overtime_policy='daily_8hr_CA': also highlight double-time when daily_hours > 12. Show the OT hours as a separate '+X.X OT' suffix in the cell

Add shift differential column: for each day row, call getShiftDifferential(employeeId, date) — GET /api/erp/shift-differential/:employeeId/:date — and display the differential amount earned (formatted as '+$X.XX' or '+X%'). Show a tooltip explaining the calculation (rate × hours)

Add timecard approval workflow status indicator. Each timecard week has a status: draft | submitted | approved | locked. Display a status badge at the top of the week view. Add action buttons based on current status and user clearance: operator sees 'Submit for Approval' (draft→submitted); hr_manager sees 'Approve' (submitted→approved) and 'Reject' (submitted→draft); admin sees 'Lock' (approved→locked). Call PATCH /api/erp/timecard-status with { employeeId, week_start, status, change_reason? }

Add a 'Export CSV' button in the header. On click, build a CSV string with columns: employee_id, employee_name, date, day_of_week, setup_hours, production_hours, idle_hours, total_hours, ot_hours, shift_differential, weekly_ot_hours, status. Format dates as MM/DD/YYYY. Trigger browser download via URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' })). Filename: timecard_[employeeName]_[weekStart].csv. Include ADP-compatible column headers as a comment row (prefix with #)
Run npm run build:fast and fix any TypeScript errors

deliverables.description: Per-day setup/production/idle breakdown, OT highlighting per FLSA daily+weekly rules, shift differential column, approval workflow status+actions, ADP/Paychex CSV export
getShiftDifferential() and updateTimecardStatus() API methods added

exit_conditions: Each day row shows setup_hours, production_hours, idle_hours as separate values
Days with >8 hours show yellow OT highlight with '+X.X OT' suffix
Weekly total >40 shows orange highlight on the weekly summary row
Shift differential column shows per-day earned differential with tooltip
Status badge shows current workflow state (draft/submitted/approved/locked)
Operator can submit; hr_manager can approve or reject; admin can lock
CSV export downloads with correct columns and ADP-compatible header comment
Locked timecards: all edit actions disabled (read-only state)
npm run build:fast passes with 0 errors

units.title: Enhance PayrollPage with full payroll cycle workflow

steps.instruction: Read web/src/pages/PayrollPage.tsx in full (351 lines) to understand existing period list, state, and current API calls

Add period type selector to the 'Create Period' modal: a <select> with options [weekly, biweekly, semi_monthly] plus a start_date date picker and an end_date field (auto-calculated based on type). Call POST /api/erp/payroll-period with { type, start_date, end_date }

On the pay stub preview / period detail view, display a deductions breakdown table with rows: Gross Pay, Federal Income Tax (calculated at effective rate from W-4 brackets — use simplified single/married brackets), State Income Tax (show a configurable state_tax_rate field, default 0%), FICA Social Security (6.2% up to $168,600 annual wage base for 2026), FICA Medicare (1.45% + 0.9% additional for wages >$200k), 401k Employee Contribution (configurable percentage, default 0%), Health Insurance (configurable flat dollar, default $0), Net Pay. Display each row with gross amount, deduction amount, and running net

Add YTD earnings section to each employee's pay stub view: call getEmployeeYTD(employeeId, year) — GET /api/erp/employee-ytd/:employeeId/:year — and display: YTD Gross, YTD Federal Tax, YTD FICA, YTD Net, YTD OT Hours, YTD OT Pay. Show these as a summary card above the current period detail

Apply shift differential to gross pay calculation: read each employee's shift_differential from their record. If shift_differential_type='flat_dollar', add (shift_differential_rate * shift_hours_this_period) to gross. If 'percent_of_base', add (base_pay * shift_differential_rate / 100). Show as a separate line item 'Shift Differential: +$X.XX' in the deductions table above gross

Add payroll period lifecycle state machine in the UI. Period status: draft | calculating | review | finalized. Show a status stepper at the top of the period detail (four steps with checkmarks). Add action buttons: 'Run Payroll' (draft→calculating, calls POST /api/erp/payroll-run/:periodId), 'Review' tab auto-opens when status=calculating→review, 'Finalize' button (review→finalized, calls POST /api/erp/payroll-finalize/:periodId, requires hr_manager clearance). Finalized periods are read-only
Run npm run build:fast and fix any TypeScript errors

deliverables.description: Period type selector (weekly/biweekly/semi-monthly), deductions breakdown table (Federal/State/FICA/401k/Health/Net), YTD earnings card, shift differential line item, period lifecycle stepper with run/review/finalize actions
getEmployeeYTD(), runPayroll(), finalizePayroll() API methods added

exit_conditions: Create Period modal shows weekly/biweekly/semi-monthly options with auto-calculated end_date

GET /api/erp/employee-ytd/:employeeId/:year route does not exist

scrutiny_focus: FLSA OT: daily OT threshold must be per overtime_policy (8hr daily CA vs 40hr weekly FLSA)
FICA SS wage base: must cap at $168,600 annual — not per-period — requires YTD accumulation check
Payroll finalization: must be irreversible in the UI (no 'Unfinalize' button — matches legal requirement)
Deductions: all tax rates must be clearly labeled as estimates (not official IRS guidance)
CSV export: locked timecards should not be re-submittable — status check before enabling submit button

phases.title: Employee Lifecycle & Audit Trail
phases.description: Add hire-to-termination lifecycle management (onboarding checklist, status transitions, offboarding) and a SOX/ISO-compliant timecard audit trail with immutable log records and an HR-facing audit viewer.

units.title: Add Employee Lifecycle Management (onboarding, status transitions, offboarding)

steps.instruction: Add an 'Onboarding' modal to EmployeeDirectoryPage.tsx that opens when creating a new employee. The modal renders a sequential checklist with 7 steps: (1) Create User Account — shows a 'Create Auth Account' button that calls POST /api/auth/create-user; (2) Assign Role — shows the clearance_level dropdown; (3) Security Clearance — checkbox 'Background check received'; (4) Required Training — links to the Learning tab and shows required courses for the role; (5) Machine Access — shows the machine cert gates from the MACHINE_CERT_REQUIREMENTS map; (6) Badge/Equipment Issued — free-text notes field; (7) First Day Complete — date picker. Each step has a completion checkbox. The checklist status is stored via PATCH /api/erp/employee/:id/onboarding

Add employee status management to the employee card/row. Current status is one of: active | on_leave | inactive | terminated. Display as a colored badge. Add a 'Change Status' dropdown button visible to hr_manager+: (a) active → on_leave: requires a return_date field and change_reason; (b) active → inactive: requires change_reason (reversible); (c) on_leave → active: no extra fields needed; (d) inactive → active: requires change_reason; (e) any → terminated: shows a warning modal 'This is IRREVERSIBLE. Type the employee name to confirm.' Requires change_reason and confirmation. All transitions call PATCH /api/erp/employee-status with { employeeId, new_status, change_reason, return_date? }

Add an 'Offboarding' modal that opens automatically when status is set to terminated. The modal renders: (1) Revoke System Access — shows a 'Revoke Now' button calling DELETE /api/auth/user/:userId; (2) Return Equipment checklist — free-text notes; (3) Final Paycheck — shows a button 'Calculate Final Pay' that calls GET /api/erp/final-paycheck/:employeeId and displays gross, deductions, net for the current partial pay period; (4) Separation Paperwork — checkbox with upload placeholder; (5) Exit Interview — date picker field. Steps are completable checkboxes. Submit calls POST /api/erp/employee/:id/offboarding

Add the employee_update_status action to businessDispatcher: in src/tools/dispatchers/businessDispatcher.ts, add 'employee_update_status' to the z.enum action list. Add the case handler to call employeeEngine.updateStatus(employeeId, new_status, change_reason, actorId). The action schema in src/schemas/businessActionSchemas.ts should define: employeeId (string), new_status (z.enum(['active', 'on_leave', 'inactive', 'terminated'])), change_reason (string min 3 chars), return_date (optional ISO string), actorId (string)
Run npm run build:fast and fix any TypeScript errors

deliverables.description: Onboarding 7-step checklist modal, status badge with Change Status dropdown, offboarding modal triggered on termination
employee_update_status action added to z.enum and case handler wired to employeeEngine.updateStatus()
EmployeeUpdateStatusSchema with employeeId, new_status enum, change_reason min 3, optional return_date, actorId

employee_update_status in businessDispatcher z.enum, builds with 0 TypeScript errors

units.title: Add Timecard Audit Trail with SOX/ISO compliance and HR audit viewer

steps.instruction: Create migration src/db/migrations/013-timecard-audit-log.sql: CREATE TABLE timecard_audit_log (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES job_time_entries(id), actor_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, actor_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('create', 'edit', 'approve', 'reject', 'lock', 'close_forgotten')), field_changed VARCHAR(50), old_value TEXT, new_value TEXT, change_reason TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()). Add index on entry_id and on actor_id. The created_at column must have a DEFAULT NOW() and must NOT allow UPDATE (enforce via trigger or application layer). Include the SQL for a trigger: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prevent_audit_update() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Audit log records are immutable'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql; CREATE TRIGGER no_audit_update BEFORE UPDATE ON timecard_audit_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_audit_update();

Wire audit log writes in src/routes/erp.ts: wherever a job_time_entry is edited (PATCH /api/erp/job-time/:id), append a row to timecard_audit_log with actor_id from the JWT token, action='edit', field_changed, old_value (fetched before update), new_value, change_reason from request body. Where shift clock-out is forced (POST /api/erp/shift-clock-out with forced=true), log action='close_forgotten'. Where timecard status changes (PATCH /api/erp/timecard-status), log action equal to the new status (approve, reject, lock)

Add GET /api/erp/timecard-audit-log route to src/routes/erp.ts. Query params: employeeId (required), start_date (optional ISO), end_date (optional ISO). Returns paginated results (page, page_size=20 default, total_count). Requires clearance_level >= 'hr_manager' via requireRole middleware
Add getTimecardAuditLog(employeeId: string, startDate?: string, endDate?: string, page?: number) to web/src/api/client.ts — calls GET /api/erp/timecard-audit-log with query params

Add an 'Audit Log' tab to the TimecardPage.tsx week view. Tab is visible only to hr_manager+ users. The tab renders a table with columns: Date/Time | Actor | Action | Field Changed | Old Value | New Value | Change Reason. Support date range filter (default: current week). Show a 'No edits this period' empty state when no records exist. Records cannot be deleted from this view
Run npm run build:fast and fix any TypeScript errors

deliverables.description: Immutable audit log table with prevent_update trigger, indexes on entry_id and actor_id
Audit log writes on edit/close_forgotten/approve/reject/lock; GET audit log endpoint with hr_manager auth
Audit Log tab showing edit history with date filter, visible to hr_manager+ only

exit_conditions: Migration 013 applies cleanly: timecard_audit_log table created with prevent_update trigger
Editing a job_time_entry writes a row to audit log with old_value, new_value, change_reason, actor_id
Forced clock-out logs action='close_forgotten' with change_reason
Approve/reject/lock timecard status changes logged with correct action label
GET /api/erp/timecard-audit-log returns paginated results, requires hr_manager auth
Audit Log tab in TimecardPage visible only to hr_manager+ users
Audit records cannot be modified or deleted via any UI action
npm run build:fast passes with 0 errors
abort_criteria: Database is not PostgreSQL (trigger syntax is PG-specific)
PATCH /api/erp/job-time/:id route does not exist to instrument
JWT token does not include actor identity fields (sub or user_id)
units.rollback: Drop migration 013 (DROP TABLE IF EXISTS timecard_audit_log CASCADE); revert erp.ts audit log writes and GET endpoint; revert TimecardPage.tsx to remove Audit Log tab; remove getTimecardAuditLog from client.ts

scrutiny_focus: Immutability: prevent_update trigger must fire on any attempt to UPDATE timecard_audit_log — verify with a direct SQL UPDATE attempt in test
Termination irreversibility: UI must have no path back from 'terminated' status — guard at both frontend and backend
Audit log authorization: GET endpoint must reject shop_floor tokens with 403
Onboarding idempotency: re-clicking a completed step must not duplicate checklist entries
Offboarding: revoke access must call DELETE /api/auth/user — a failed revoke must block the offboarding submission

phases.title: Department Dashboard Live Wiring
phases.description: Replace all seed/mock data in DepartmentDashboardPage with real API calls: live who's-clocked-in from whoClockedIn(), active jobs per machine from dispatch queue, utilization % from employeeUtilization(), downtime Pareto from pause_periods, cost per department from employeeDeptSummary(), and foreman controls for OT approval and operator reassignment.

units.title: Wire DepartmentDashboardPage to 100% real live data

steps.instruction: Read web/src/pages/DepartmentDashboardPage.tsx in full to identify every location where mock/seed data, hardcoded arrays, or fixture imports are used. List each one as a comment before proceeding

Wire the 'Who's Clocked In' panel: replace mock data with getWhoClockedIn(departmentId?: string) — GET /api/erp/who-clocked-in with optional dept query param. Returns Array<{ employeeId, employeeName, clock_in_time, active_job_number?, active_machine_id? }>. Display each entry as a card with name, clock-in duration (live timer), current job if available

Wire the 'Active Jobs per Machine' panel: replace mock data with getActiveMachineJobs(departmentId?: string) — GET /api/erp/active-machine-jobs with optional dept param. Returns Array<{ machine_id, machine_name, active_job_number?, operator_name?, status: 'running' | 'idle' | 'paused' | 'down' }>. Display as a machine grid with status color coding

Wire the 'Utilization %' panel: replace mock data with getEmployeeUtilization(departmentId: string, date: string) — GET /api/erp/employee-utilization?departmentId=X&date=Y. Returns Array<{ employeeId, name, productive_hours, total_clock_hours, utilization_pct }>. Display as a horizontal bar chart per employee using Recharts BarChart

Wire the 'Downtime Reasons' Pareto chart: replace mock data with getDowntimePareto(departmentId: string, start_date: string, end_date: string) — GET /api/erp/downtime-pareto with query params. The backend aggregates pause_periods by reason_category and returns Array<{ reason_category, total_minutes, count, pct_of_total }> sorted descending. Render as a Recharts ComposedChart with bars (minutes) and a cumulative % line

Wire the 'Cost per Department' summary: replace mock data with getEmployeeDeptSummary(departmentId: string, period_start: string, period_end: string) — GET /api/erp/dept-summary with query params. Returns { total_labor_cost, total_hours, ot_hours, ot_cost, avg_utilization_pct, headcount_active }. Display as a KPI card grid

Add foreman controls section (visible to clearance_level >= 'lead'): (a) Reassign Operator: a dropdown to pick an operator and a target machine, then call POST /api/erp/reassign-operator with { employeeId, from_machine_id, to_machine_id, reason }; (b) Approve OT: a table of employees whose current shift has exceeded 8 hours without approved OT — each row has an 'Approve OT' button calling POST /api/erp/approve-ot with { employeeId, date, approved_by }. Both actions require the user to have clearance_level >= 'lead'
Add all six API functions to web/src/api/client.ts: getWhoClockedIn(), getActiveMachineJobs(), getEmployeeUtilization(), getDowntimePareto(), getEmployeeDeptSummary(), reassignOperator(), approveOT()
Set up auto-refresh for the 'Who's Clocked In' and 'Active Jobs' panels using setInterval at 30-second intervals. Clear intervals on component unmount. Add a 'Last updated X seconds ago' indicator
Run npm run build:fast and fix any TypeScript errors

hook.description: Warn if the prevent_audit_update trigger definition is removed or the UPDATE restriction is weakened — audit log immutability is a SOX/ISO compliance requirement

mcp_action.description: Transition employee lifecycle status (active/on_leave/inactive/terminated) with required change_reason and actor tracking — wires to EmployeeEngine.updateStatus() with audit trail

skill_enhancement.enhancement: HR workflow patterns: immutable audit logs with PostgreSQL triggers, FLSA daily+weekly OT calculation from overtime_policy field, payroll deduction breakdown (FICA wage base cap, shift differential line items), irreversible termination with typed-name confirmation gate, SOX-compliant timecard approval workflow (draft→submitted→approved→locked)

enforcement.build_gate: npm run build:fast must pass after each unit before proceeding to next unit
enforcement.no_mock_data: All API calls in completed units must target real backend routes — no fixture JSON, hardcoded arrays, or Math.random() data generation in any component touched by this milestone
enforcement.change_reason_required: Every HR override action (manager edit, forced clock-out, status change, timecard approve/reject/lock) must require a non-empty change_reason before the API call is made
enforcement.audit_immutability: The timecard_audit_log table must never have UPDATE or DELETE routes exposed — only INSERT via instrumented backend actions and SELECT via the hr_manager audit viewer
enforcement.termination_irreversible: Once an employee status is set to 'terminated', the UI must have no path back to any other status — this must be enforced at both the frontend dropdown (omit non-terminated options) and the backend (return 409 if new_status !== 'terminated' for a terminated employee)
enforcement.no_passthrough: No .passthrough() in any Zod schema added or modified in this milestone
enforcement.fica_wage_base: FICA Social Security deduction must check YTD gross against the $168,600 wage base before applying the 6.2% rate — never apply SS tax beyond this cap

exit_conditions: EmployeeDirectoryPage edit modal saves clearance_level, overtime_policy, shift_differential to backend
Cert expiry warnings show for any cert expiring within 30 days
Manager can close forgotten shifts and edit time entries — both require non-empty change_reason
EmployeeProfilePage Learning tab shows course progress, cert status, and machine access gates
TimecardPage shows setup vs production vs idle hours per day
OT highlighting applies correct threshold per employee overtime_policy (daily CA or weekly FLSA)
Timecard approval workflow: draft → submitted → approved → locked; locked = read-only
CSV export downloads ADP/Paychex compatible file
PayrollPage deductions breakdown shows Federal, State, FICA SS (capped), FICA Medicare, 401k, Health, Net
YTD card shows earnings for the current calendar year
Payroll period finalization is irreversible in the UI
Onboarding 7-step checklist modal works on employee creation
Termination requires typed-name confirmation and triggers offboarding modal
employee_update_status action wired in businessDispatcher with correct schema
timecard_audit_log table created with immutable trigger; every edit/approve/lock/close writes a record
Audit Log tab in TimecardPage visible to hr_manager+, shows paginated history
DepartmentDashboardPage has zero mock/seed/fixture data — all 6 panels call real APIs
Department dashboard auto-refreshes who-clocked-in and active-jobs every 30 seconds without memory leak
npm run build:fast clean (0 errors), all affected tests pass
